name: Gift pool
summary: Friends chip in equal shares toward one gift; a jar fills with coins and stragglers get a nudge.
useWhen: a group gift for someone not in the chat
'everyone venmo me $30 for jake's headphones', 'are we doing a gift for mom'
dontUseWhen: splitting a bill that's already paid (use a bill split)
the person is in the chat (it is a surprise tool)

recipient.description: Who the gift is for, e.g. 'Jake'

quote.description: What the recipient said about it
